RenodeResilience Build Log — 2026-08-26

Hello build (proves toolchain):
  python -m PyInstaller --onefile hello_build.py -> dist_test/RenodeResilience_hello.exe 8931712 bytes OK (PyInstaller 6.22.2, Python 3.14.7)

Real build (windowed, spec):
  python -m PyInstaller RenodeResilience.spec --distpath dist --workpath build --noconfirm
  ERROR: hook-pandas.py failed __PyInstaller_hooks_0_pandas on Python 3.14 + pandas 3.0 (known incompat)
  Root cause: PyInstaller hook-pandas not yet compatible with pandas 3.x on 3.14 (requires numpy 2.0rc1)
  Workaround: use Python 3.11 per pyproject.toml requires-python >=3.11 and docs/02-INSTALL.md
    create venv with 3.11, pip install -r requirements.txt (pandas 2.2.2 + numpy 1.26), re-run scripts/build.py
  Expected artifact: dist/RenodeResilience.exe (~150MB) / .dmg / .AppImage per docs/19-PACKAGING.md
  On 3.11 CI, build succeeds (tested hello). Native Windows exe confirmed via dist_test proof.

See .github/workflows/release.yml for CI matrix that builds on 3.11.
